davmail_server.description: If true, run in headless server mode (no GUI). See davmail(1) -server option.

davmail_enable_tray.description: If true, show system tray icon even when davmail.server=true. Ignored if davmail.server=false.

davmail_imap_port.description: Port to bind the IMAP service.

davmail_imap_bind.description: IP address to bind IMAP service (0.0.0.0 = all interfaces).

davmail_smtp_port.description: Port to bind the SMTP service.

davmail_smtp_bind.description: IP address to bind SMTP service.

davmail_pop_port.description: Port to bind the POP3 service.

davmail_pop_bind.description: IP address to bind POP3 service.

davmail_caldav_port.description: Port to bind the CalDAV service.

davmail_caldav_bind.description: IP address to bind CalDAV service.

davmail_carddav_port.description: Port to bind the CardDAV service.

davmail_carddav_bind.description: IP address to bind CardDAV service.

davmail_ldap_port.description: Port to bind the LDAP service.

davmail_ldap_bind.description: IP address to bind LDAP service.

davmail_enable_ssl.description: If true, enable SSL/TLS using keystore.

davmail_keystore_path.description: Absolute path to the keystore file (required if SSL enabled).

davmail_truststore_path.description: Optional absolute path to truststore file.

davmail_certificate_validation.description: Certificate validation mode. Allowed: 'none', 'peer'. See davmail SSL setup docs.

davmail_ssl_noverify.description: If true and certificateValidation=none, skip SSL verification. Not recommended in production.

davmail_proxy_enabled.description: If true, enable HTTP proxy for Exchange connectivity.

davmail_proxy_password.description: Proxy password (optional, required if proxyUser is set).

davmail_log_level.description: Log level: TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR. See davmail logging docs.
